qualitative_depth_rule: Verified sea shoal and coastal subtidal seagrass habitats qualify for Shallow. A primary source that explicitly identifies the sample or strain as hadal qualifies for Hadal. These observations carry no numeric depth value.
unknown: No single eligible display band; not synonymous with no depth in the paper.
grain: Compound records; source profiles are not unique authenticated strains; location labels are not sampling events.
